board.name: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners (LSBME)

ce.reason: Renewal requires current NCCPA certification and the CE needed to maintain it; the state sets no hour count.

notes.text: All LSBME licensees track CE in CE Broker; renewal is blocked if CE Broker does not show the required credits.

topics.label: Board approved CDS prescribing practices (drug diversion, best practices, treatment of addiction), once, as a prerequisite to renewal; exempt by attesting no CDS was prescribed in the expiring year

condition.field: Holds a state controlled substance registration
condition.question: Do you hold a Louisiana controlled dangerous substance (CDS) license?
condition.description: Applies to holders of the state controlled substance license.

topics.label: LSBME online Laws and Rules Course, before the first renewal

condition.question: Is this your first renewal of this license?
condition.description: Some boards require a course at the first renewal only.

agreement.text: PAs practice under a board approved supervising physician; changes in supervising physicians are reported within 15 days, and clinical practice guidelines and any written practice agreement are reviewed, updated and signed annually.

ce.reason: The RN license renews on 30 contact hours, or 900 employer-verified practice hours, in the two-year period; a nationally certified APRN meets it by holding an approved certification.

options.text: At least 30 board approved contact hours of continuing education in the two-year licensure period
At least 900 practice hours in the two-year licensure period, verified by your employer
For a nationally board certified APRN: holding an approved national certification

unverified: Which certifying bodies' certifications the board approves for APRNs meeting the RN renewal

ce.reason: A nationally certified APRN renews by keeping current national certification; no APRN contact hour total is set.

cycleYears.reason: The APRN license expires with the biennial RN license.

topics.label: Pharmacotherapeutics in your role and population focus: 6 contact hours each year, 12 over the two-year license (the board audits 12); controlled substance prescribing hours count toward the year they were taken
Board approved controlled substance prescribing practices, once, as a prerequisite to renewal; exempt by attesting no controlled substance was prescribed in the expiring period

condition.field: Holds a state controlled substance registration
condition.question: Do you hold a Louisiana controlled dangerous substance (CDS) license?
condition.description: Applies to holders of the state controlled substance license.

agreement.text: An APRN engaged in medical diagnosis and management has a collaborative practice agreement, reviewed and signed at least annually; changes in collaborating physicians are reported within 30 days.
